programme.desc: S2026 E38 — Viking v Bayern Munich Viking v Bayern Munich (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the league phase match from Lyse Arena in Stavanger, Norway. The visitors got their Champions League campaign off to the perfect start last month with a 5-0 win at home to Bodo/Glimt. It was 0-0 at half-time but goals from Jamal Musiala, Harry Kane, Alphonso Davies and a Michael Olise brace gave them a comfortable victory in the end.
programme.title: Live UEFA Champions League

programme.desc: S2026 E43 — Aston Villa v Fenerbahce Aston Villa v Fenerbahce (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the league phase match from Villa Park. Underfire Villa made a perfect start to their Champions League campaign last month with a 3-2 victory away at Club Brugge. First-half goals from John McGinn, Emi Buendia and Nicolas Jackson gave Villa a 3-1 lead at half-time, and despite a Nicolo Tresoldi penalty halving the deficit, they held on for the last 29 minutes of the game.
programme.title: Live UEFA Champions League

programme.desc: S2026 E42 — Roma v Real Madrid AS Roma v Real Madrid (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the league phase match from Stadio Olimpico. Jose Mourinho's first Champions League game back as Real Madrid boss ended in victory last month as they beat Inter Milan 2-1 thanks to first-half goals from Kylian Mbappe and Federico Valverde. The hosts were held to a 1-1 draw at Fenerbahce in their first game of the competition, as Englishman Archie Brown scored the equaliser for the Turkish side.
programme.title: Live UEFA Champions League
